patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: (Mom) He's got this awful barky, seal-like cough and a hoarse voice, worse tonight. He's breathing okay at rest — no whistling when he's calm — but that cough is scary.
presentation.triageNote: 2-year-old male with a barky, seal-like cough and hoarse voice that worsened tonight. He has no stridor while resting, appears comfortable, is drinking, and remains well hydrated.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this mild croup presentation has no stridor at rest, respiratory distress, dehydration, or counted emergency resource need.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This toddler has a barky cough and hoarse voice but is comfortable, drinking, hydrated, and free of resting stridor.
clinical.acuityReason: The absence of resting noise or increased work of breathing supports a mild upper-airway illness manageable with oral medication.
teachingPoints: Stridor at rest, retractions, fatigue, cyanosis, drooling, or toxic appearance would require escalation.
A single oral steroid dose reduces symptom duration and return visits.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Oral medication, home comfort measures, and airway return precautions would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: on a parent's lap-style seat, mid barky cough
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 2-year-old boy in pajamas, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: mid-cough, hand near his mouth. Expression: tired and a little teary. Clearly visible: a barky-cough posture and flushed cheeks. No text, no logos.
